_note: Avionics-local numbers (F3, revision F3-R2 on params A1-R3, 2026-11-09). Shared numbers (pod LE, size, base, board thickness, pitot tip) come from redesign/params/params.json; pod stations (floor, plates, channels, tie posts, GPS pad, pitot socket) come from subsystems/pod/fusion/pod.py#layout() and subsystems/pod/params.json, so the avionics sit on the pod as D2 built it. Read by subsystems/avionics/fusion/avionics.py and team/F3/avn_data.py. Metres unless stated. Envelopes of bought parts are the seller's figures, UNVERIFIED until measured on arrival (T-F3-ARRIVAL).

fc_board_m.note: CoreWing F405 Wing APP V2 FC board alone (top board + wireless app board), L x W x H. The power board (PWR-003) is separated and sits on the PDB plate (F2 ASM-F2-PWR-STACK, F1); measure the split stack on arrival

fc_mass_g.source: SRC-F3-FC-ALONE (flymod.net 8.9 g FC) + 3 g wireless board EST
fc_mass_g.note: the 40 g catalogue figure is the full stack incl. the power board; the power board mass (~28 g EST) belongs to PWR-003 at its own station (CR-F3-13)

fc_arrow.note: board flat, arrow to the cruise nose; AHRS_ORIENTATION 0

pad_m.note: four silicone gel cubes (Zeal / alpha-gel class, 5 mm sheet) under the board corners; size set for f_n ~ 36 Hz with the 12 g board at E = 30 kPa (ASM-F3-ISOLATOR)

pad_inset_m.note: pad edge to board edge, keeps pads clear of edge components

gel_e_pa.note: compressive modulus of the gel at small strain; checked on the bench by the 100 g sag test (BUILD.md step 3)

rx_m.source: SRC-F3-RP3-SPEC (22 x 13 x 4 mm, 4.6 g with two 65 mm antennas)
rx_m.note: laid crosswise (22 mm along y) on the avionics plate aft of the aft tie post, under antenna tube A (x -0.054)

rx_gap_m.note: gap from the aft tie post to the RX front edge

aspd_m.source: SRC-F3-RMRC-ASPD (20 x 21 x 13 mm incl. ports, 3.5 g board)
aspd_m.note: RMRC digital airspeed (MS4525DO) board, ports up; sits between D2's two tie posts (inner faces 20 mm apart: a locating fit, CR-F3-12 asks +1 mm)

aspd_post_dx_m.source: subsystems/pod/fusion/pod.py (tie posts at avn_plate_x_m[0] + 8 / + 32 mm; literals there, CR-F3-12)

aspd_port_m.note: port centres: x from the board front, y spacing (total, static)

tube_m.source: RMRC / Pixhawk-class silicone pitot tubing, OD x ID

tube_cut_m.note: each line, sensor port to boom coupler, with a 10 mm service loop; limit 0.060

probe_od_m.source: UNVERIFIED (pitot-static tube in the RMRC kit; measure)
probe_od_m.note: sleeve bore is printed to the measured OD + 0.1 mm and the probe bonded in

barb_m.note: probe root barbs: diameter x length aft of the sleeve, y spacing = aspd_port_m[1]

sleeve_m.source: params avionics.pitot_tip_xyz_m note (6 mm keyed boom) + F3
sleeve_m.note: OD, width across the key flat (flat on +z), length ahead of the socket collar

shoulder_m.note: printed shoulder ring OD x length, bears on the socket collar's front face: drag in cruise and gravity in hover both push the boom home (+x)

sd_proud_m.source: F3 choice (card slot at the FC fore edge, measure)

consumables_g.note: booked in AVN-006 with the gel pads: tape for GPS, RX, airspeed; 3 ties (airspeed, GPS cable, tubes); 10 mm hook-and-loop strap over the FC (C6 secondary retention)
